limitations: Generated head/body masters remain more photographic than Nova_informal.png's soft illustrated cast style.
Independent source renders still show small face-to-neck tone and body/head proportion mismatches; the straight shoulder hair also retains a blunt end. The visual gate is open.

Across two 3x throttled Android Chromium runs at 390x844, cold composition was 812-1052 ms and warm composition 17-20 ms; retained RGBA was 30.3 MiB with a conservative 72.3 MiB temporary bound. The cold cost and memory bound keep production optimization blocked pending device-class review.
The narrow run is headless browser emulation at 390x844 CSS pixels and DPR 2, not a physical or native-device measurement.
Original image-generation prompts were not retained and commercial usage/rights were not reviewed; art provenance is incomplete for production release.
